---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new capability or an improvement to an existing one
title: "[Improvement] "
labels: improvement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

The capability being requested, in a sentence or two.

## Problem

The server-administration problem this would solve, and how it is handled today without it.

## Proposed Solution

What the plugin would do. Where a command is involved, give the proposed syntax, the permission
node it should require, and an example of its output.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches that were weighed, including doing nothing.

## Privacy Impact

Whether the proposal would surface a player's IP address anywhere — chat output, logs,
tab-completion, hover or click text, notifications. Direct IP disclosure has been deliberately
removed from this plugin, so a proposal that reintroduces it needs a justification.

## Additional Context

Anything else worth knowing — the server setup it is wanted for, related issues, prior art in
other plugins.
